**Finding submitted: deviation on LOL-CAP (p0077).**

- **What we found:** The Agreement's only liability ceiling sits at the end of the indemnity section and caps *TrueLink alone*, and even then only for matters "arising under or related to Section 3, 4, 7 and 11" — sections that do not exist in this document. Client's liability, including the very broad Section 12a indemnity and its confidentiality obligations, is unlimited. No indirect/consequential damages exclusion exists anywhere (confirmed by searches across §§ 2, 5, 8, 10 and 12).
- **Why it fails fallback:** Customer uncapped while Vendor is capped is walk-away territory; carve-outs are also one-sided (only TrueLink's gross negligence/wilful misconduct).
- **Cure (fallback target, one surgical replace):** Cap made mutual and aggregate for the whole Agreement, the dangling Section 3/4/7/11 reference removed, the existing 12-month compensation basis preserved verbatim, and indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct expressly outside the cap. Preferred items (USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential waiver, data-protection/fraud/IP carve-outs, payment-obligation exclusion) are noted in the rationale as available but not pressed.
